hard_checks: pricing_results.csv has exactly the six contracted columns and eight data rows in scenario_grid order
every American price, Delta, Gamma, intrinsic value, and early-exercise premium matches the CRR gold value to 4-decimal precision
the base-case price, Delta, and Gamma use option_terms.json and are not taken from a scenario row
scenario_count equals the number of data rows in scenario_grid.csv
highest_price_scenario is the scenario with the largest rounded price, first row on ties
summary.json contains exactly the five contracted keys
method_notes: CRR tree with u = exp(sigma*sqrt(dt)), d = 1/u, p = (exp((r-q)*dt) - d)/(u - d), df = exp(-r*dt)
American values take max(continuation, intrinsic) at every node including the root
early_exercise_premium is the American price minus the European price from the same tree
Delta and Gamma use the American-tree node values at steps 1 and 2
